hypothesis.statement: Classical Lienard systems x' = y - F(x), y' = -x with F a real polynomial of degree 6 have at most 4 limit cycles.
hypothesis.anchor: openai/math family 143 (QuinticLienard.lean): degree <= 5 has at most 2 limit cycles, 2 attained. A claim by another model, Lean-stated, NOT compiled here.
hypothesis.literature: De Maesschalck & Dumortier, 'Classical Lienard equations of degree n >= 6 can have [(n-1)/2]+2 limit cycles', J. Differential Equations 250(4) (2011) 2162-2176, doi:10.1016/j.jde.2010.12.003: degree 6 with 4 limit cycles, via slow-fast (canard) theory.

attempts: documentserver.uhasselt.be/bitstream/1942/11743/1/morelc-jde-final.pdf: WebFetch 503; curl returned an HTML page 'Document Server temporarily available only on campus and via VPN'

PMC3988861 (Wu et al. 2014, citing paper): verbal description only: 'four limit cycles bifurcated from the canard cycle of a singular perturbed Lienard system of degree six, which consists of a single fast orbit and a single slow curve and contains one turning point'; slow divergence integral Int(x1,x2) = -int_{x1}^{x2} F0'(x)^2/g(x) dx
NTDS2012 slides (Li Chengzhi, gsd.uab.cat): cite the result, no construction
paper_access.consequence: the family is RECONSTRUCTED from that description and standard canard theory, not copied from the paper: x' = y - (a x + F0(x)), y' = -eps x, F0(0)=F0'(0)=0, F0''(0)=1; one turning point at the origin; k simple zeros of I(x_R) = int_{x_L}^{x_R} F0'(x)^2/x dx (F0(x_L)=F0(x_R)) give k+1 cycles for small eps with a tuned. 4 cycles needs k = 3 at degree 6. Classical form: F = (a x + F0(x))/sqrt(eps), same degree.

instrument.integration: hand-driven step loop over scipy OdeSolver classes; wall-clock deadline and step cap checked after every step; timeouts recorded as status 'timeout' and never counted
instrument.map: two-sided shooting from (0, Y), Y > 0: forward and backward to the first landing on {x = 0, y < 0}; D(Y) = fwd - bwd; where one direction escapes to infinity, the same-sign full-return surrogate (status ok_fr / ok_br) is used
instrument.confirmation: a sign change of D between adjacent grid points counts as a CONFIRMED cycle only if, at both grid ends, Radau 1e-10, DOP853 1e-12 and Radau 1e-11 give the same sign and |D| > 10 x the spread between the three
instrument.a_tuning: A(Y) = value of a with D(Y; a) = 0, by 41-point bracket + 70-step bisection with DOP853 rtol 1e-12 (search aid only). `level` ranks up to 3 distinct levels by how often the sampled A curve crosses them (ranked_levels). Cycles are counted and confirmed at ONE (F0, eps, a) point per count. Counts at different a are never added.
instrument.lower_bound_only: semistable (even-order) cycles and cycles inside one grid cell are invisible

verdict_categories.REFUTED: controls pass and >= 5 confirmed cycles at one degree-6 parameter point
verdict_categories.CONTRADICTS_UPSTREAM: controls pass and >= 3 confirmed cycles at one degree-5 parameter point; reported prominently whatever the H4 verdict
verdict_categories.NOT_REFUTED: all controls pass including P4 (>= 4 confirmed at degree 6 reproduced) and no point reaches 5 at degree 6; stated with the searched region
verdict_categories.PARTIAL: instrument controls pass but P4 fails: 'instrument cannot reach the known regime'; no claim about H4 beyond the controls
verdict_categories.CRASH: an instrument control (C1-C3) or the canard negative control N2 fails; no number from the run is evidence

decision_rule: H4 REFUTED iff >= 5 confirmed cycles at a single degree-6 (F, a, eps) point with all controls passed. Any confirmed 3 at degree 5 contradicts upstream's formal theorem and is reported prominently. Stage 3 (search for 5) runs only if P4 passes; if P4 fails the lane is PARTIAL. SDI-level observations (zeros of I without an ODE count) are reported as theory-level and never enter the verdict.

controls.C1_positive_vdp: F = 0.5 (x^3/3 - x): exactly 1 confirmed cycle (Radau) and 1 sign change (DOP853), amplitudes agree to 1e-6 relative, full-return map changes sign across the root
controls.C2_positive_avg_quintic: F = 0.01 (8x - 40/3 x^3 + 16/5 x^5): exactly 2, same checks
controls.C3_negative_random_deg34: 20 v1-generator samples (seed 2026; degree 3/4, every third averaging-structured): never > 1 with Radau or DOP853 (theorems; Li-Llibre 2012 for degree 4)
controls.N1_negative_sdi_deg4: sdi-design at degree 4 (seeds 200, 201; 400 trials each): SDI never has a sign change (k >= 1 would mean >= 2 cycles for small eps, against Li-Llibre)
controls.N2_negative_canard_deg4: degree-4 F0 = x^2/2 + 0.2 x^3 + 0.3 x^4 run through the SAME canard pipeline (curve n_y 48, level, count grid 160 at each of its top 3 levels) at every eps in eps_grid: never > 1 confirmed cycle
controls.P4_positive_lane: reproduce >= 4 confirmed cycles at one degree-6 parameter point of the reconstructed family

procedure.stage1_controls: h4_v2.py controls --part vdp | avg_quintic | negative --idx i:i+2 (10 chunks), seed 2026, n_negative 20; outputs controls/*.json
procedure.stage2a_design: h4_v2.py sdi-design --degree 6 with seeds 100, 101 (trials 1500, scale 1.0, polish 300) and 102, 103 (trials 1500, scale 1.5, polish 300); plus the primary family with --trials 0 --center <primary> --polish 300 --seed 104. Pick the k = 3 F0 with the largest strength; ties -> lower seed. Outputs design_runs/*.json (one per seed, each call <= 480 s; if a call times out the seed is reported as timed out and skipped).
procedure.stage2b_canard: for the chosen F0 and every eps in eps_grid = [0.01, 0.006, 0.004, 0.003, 0.002, 0.0015] (absolute list, fixed from the resolution smoke below): curve --n-y 48 --a-half-width 0.05 in chunks of 8 indices (if a point has no bracket, it is reported, not retried with other widths); level; count --grid 160 at each of the top 3 levels from `level`. Outputs canard/eps_<eps>/*.json. If the chosen F0 gives < 4 everywhere and differs from the primary family, the same is repeated for the primary family; then stop.
procedure.stage2_resolution_diagnostic: per eps, `level` writes A_spread_ulps = (max A - min A)/ulp(median A); below 64 the eps is recorded as 'A curve below double resolution' and smaller eps are skipped for that F0. predicted_crossings is only ever reported together with A_spread_ulps; it is a search aid, never evidence (only confirmed counts at fixed a are).
procedure.stage3_perturb: ONLY if P4 passes. (i) SDI-level: sdi-design --degree 6 --trials 200 --center <4-cycle c_high> with --scale 0.02 (seed 300) and --scale 0.05 (seed 301); the code adds ABSOLUTE noise scale * [1, 1, 0.5, 0.3] to (c3, c4, c5, c6), no polish. Every sampled k >= 4 F0 would go through stage 2b; sdi-design keeps only the best, so a k >= 4 best is the trigger. (ii) ODE-level: sdi-design --trials 20 --scale 0.02 --center <4-cycle c_high> --seed 302 --polish 0 defines one perturbed F0 (its best); that F0 and the 4-cycle F0 at the 4-cycle eps go through stage 2b again (top 3 levels). Outputs perturb/*.json. Anything else is manual and labelled as such.
procedure.stage3b_deg5_sdi: degree-5 sdi-design seeds 400, 401 (1500 trials each, scale 1.0): any k >= 2 is reported as a theory-level red flag against upstream and, if P4 passed, run through stage 2b at degree 5

primary_family.c_high_note: F0 = x^2/2 + c3 x^3 + c4 x^4 + c5 x^5 + c6 x^6; found during design smoke (probe seed 1 trial 816, then polish seeds 11 and 12)
primary_family.honest_expectation: strength = min |I_ext| / J(x_hi) = 4.2e-4. The J/eps window heuristic is pessimistic: the smoke A curve of this F0 is resolved at eps = 0.005 and 0.003 and at 1 ulp at eps = 0.001, so the reachable band is about eps in [0.0015, 0.01], where |I_ext|/eps is about 0.6 to 4. 4 cycles may or may not show there; if they do not, the lane is PARTIAL.

budget.per_call: each Bash call <= 480 s (timeout 480); every chunk writes its own JSON and reruns skip finished files
budget.per_sample: landing deadline 20 s; count deadline 420 s (positive controls), 200 s (negatives), 480 s (canard counts)
budget.wall: stage 1 <= 60 min, stage 2a <= 40 min, stage 2b <= 180 min, stage 3 <= 90 min; total <= 6 h; a stage out of budget stops and is reported as such
